backend/main.mo: Implements access‑controlled user profiles and a public feedback submission system with admin‑only retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Defines feature evidence metadata linking features to source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for all frontend source files in the project.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles and light/dark theme color variables using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing client‑side page navigation and theme provider setup.
frontend/src/components/ContentSection.t: Simple wrapper component applying consistent prose styling around content.
frontend/src/components/FeedbackForm.tsx: Feedback form with validation and submission via React Query, using shadcn/ui components.
frontend/src/components/FredWelcomeIntro: Intro screen for Ask Fred with topic cards and a call‑to‑action button to start chatting.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Internet Identity login/logout button handling auth state and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Site layout with header navigation, mobile menu, role‑based admin link, and footer.
frontend/src/content/disclaimer.ts: Exports disclaimer text blocks about legal notices, lack of affiliation, and no unblocked gameplay services.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements authentication context using Internet Identity, exposing identity state, login, and logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch the caller's user role and all feedback using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionFlag.ts: Hook that stores and syncs a boolean flag in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitFeedback.ts: Mutation hook that submits user feedback through the backend actor and invalidates feedback queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme color variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstrap file that sets up React, QueryClient, and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission info, legal notices, and the site’s disclaimers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminFeedbackPage.tsx: Admin page showing feedback submissions with authentication and role checks, including loading and access states.
frontend/src/pages/BeginnerGuidePage.tsx: Renders a beginner guide page with cards explaining elixir management, tower mechanics, and basic strategy tips. Uses UI components and icons to present structured instructional content.
frontend/src/pages/DeckTipsPage.tsx: Displays example Clash Royale decks with archetypes, elixir costs, card lists, and strengths/weaknesses. Provides structured deck guidance using cards and content sections.
frontend/src/pages/FredChatPage.tsx: Implements a chat interface for interacting with Fred, including message handling, auto-scrolling, intro display, and integration with the knowledge base. Manages user input, responses, and UI state.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with a hero section, official links, disclaimers, and introductory info about Clash Royale. Includes layout for feature sections and graphics.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeBase.ts: Defines Fred’s deterministic Q&A knowledge base with keyword-matched responses about Clash Royale basics and archetypes. Includes input normalization and keyword checking utilities.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), store/retrieve them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, fonts, container settings, animations, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current state, versioning, and a list of implemented features for a Clash Royale information website.
